text.description: Default text content. Type: string. Default is an empty string.

placeholder.description: Default prompt text for the single-line text input. Type: string. Default is an empty string.

enabled.description: Whether text input is enabled. Type: boolean. Default: true. true means enabled, false means disabled.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of input characters. Type: number. Value range: [0, inf). Default: Infinity. If unset or invalid, input length is unlimited.

type.description: Input box type. normal: basic input mode. number: digits only, without negative numbers or decimals. phoneNumber: phone number mode, supporting digits, spaces, +, -, #, and parentheses. email: email address mode.

placeholderColor.description: Placeholder text color. Hex color string. Supports #RRGGBB and #AARRGGBB. Default follows the theme.

cancelButton.description: Style of the clear button on the right. Object format: { style, fontColor, fontSize }. The icon source is fixed to the built-in delete icon. fontColor maps to the icon color, and fontSize maps to the icon size. All fields are optional. Default: { style: 'input' }.

style.description: Clear button display mode. constant: always visible. invisible: always hidden. input: visible while input exists. Default: input.

fontColor.description: Clear button icon color. Hex color string. Supports #RRGGBB and #AARRGGBB.

fontSize.description: Clear button icon size in fp.

caretColor.description: Caret color. Hex color string. Default: #007DFF. Dark theme: #5291FF. Light theme: #FF0A59F7.

selectedBackgroundColor.description: Text selection background color. Hex color string. Default is a theme color with about 20% opacity.

showUnderline.description: Whether to show the underline. Type: boolean. Default: false. true enables the underline, false disables it. The underline is supported only when type=normal.

underlineColor.description: Underline color object: { typing, normal, error, disable }. All fields are optional and use hex color strings.

normal.description: Underline color in the normal state.

error.description: Underline color in the error state.

disable.description: Underline color in the disabled state.

fontSize.description: Sets the font size in fp. Default: 16fp.

fontWeight.description: Font weight. String enum: lighter=100, normal/regular=400, medium=500, bold=700, bolder=900. Default: normal.

fontColor.description: Font color. Hex color string. Default: #E5000000. Dark theme: #99FFFFFF. Light theme: #99000000.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment. start: leading edge. center: centered. end: trailing edge. justify: justified, handled as start.

maxFontSize.description: Maximum text display size in fp. It must be used with minFontSize and maxLines or a layout size constraint; setting it alone does not take effect. When adaptive font sizing is active, fontSize does not take effect. If maxFontSize <= 0 or maxFontSize < minFontSize, fontSize or its default value is used.

minFontSize.description: Minimum text display size in fp. It must be used with maxFontSize and maxLines or a layout size constraint; setting it alone does not take effect. When adaptive font sizing is active, fontSize does not take effect. If minFontSize <= 0, fontSize or its default value is used.

wordBreak.description: Text line break rule. normal: CJK text may break between any two characters, while Non-CJK text breaks only at whitespace. breakWord: prefer break points, otherwise break between any two characters. hyphenation: try hyphenating words at line end, otherwise use breakWord.

maxLines.description: Maximum number of text lines. Type: number. Value range: (0, inf]. Default: 3. Takes effect only in inline editing mode.

fontScaleMode.description: Font scaling mode. followSystem follows the system font scale. custom uses the configured custom font scale range.

minFontScale.description: Minimum font scale. Value range: [0, 1]. Values less than 0 are clamped to 0, values greater than 1 are clamped to 1, and non-number values do not take effect.

maxFontScale.description: Maximum font scale. Value range: [1, inf). Values less than 1 are clamped to 1, and non-number values do not take effect. After this property is set, showError can scale up to 2x at most.
